description: Start a new FirmLedger Leads conversation with another approved, claimed business. The signed-in member email is used automatically, the business email stays private, and the owner is notified in their Leads inbox. Requires the user’s confirmation of the exact inquiry.

confirmation_token.description: Leave empty on the first call: you get an action_summary and a token instead of the action. After the user explicitly confirms that summary, call again with the SAME arguments plus this token.

listing.description: The company: its FirmLedger slug (best — returned by search_listings), its exact name, its FirmLedger ID such as "FL-00012", or its FirmLedger profile URL.

looking_for.description: Optional short subject or what the member needs.

name.description: Optional sender name; defaults to the member profile name.

name: start_lead
title: Contact a claimed business
